text_block_list.text:
The flow of a race can change drastically 
depending on which Umamusume are 
competing. And—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's sheer chaos this year! Absolute 
chaos! We've seen an unprecedented 
mid-race scramble unlike anything in 
recent years!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It seems even the Mejiro Umamusume were 
run ragged. What on earth is going on...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
McQueen, didn't today's race feel a bit 
weird? Like the pace and development were 
all over the place.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, the cause is most likely—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It is that Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Senior-class Umamusume... They're so 
incredible...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Even Turbo's totally wiped out~. I gotta 
get back to Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Um... Which way is forward? That way? This 
way? Which one, which one?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Traaaiineer~...
Ooooooh...?

A completely worn-out Twin Turbo... showed 
off a rather peculiar way of walking.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why's Turbo getting further away from 
the grandstand? Let's try again...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Heave-ho, heave... ho...
Oooooh...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what a dexterous way to walk. It's 
like she's walking on a treadmill.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Fufu... what an interesting girl.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Putting on a frantic race with her 
running, and thrilling the fans with her 
performance after crossing the finish 
line...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, this year's Arima Kinen 
became a race truly worthy of a grand 
festival.

Twin Turbo electrifies the crowd both 
before and after a race. But she doesn't 
do it on purpose.

It all came down to her innate nature to 
see everything through to the very end.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Trainer, where are you~?

And so, welcoming an utterly exhausted 
Twin Turbo, this year drew to a close.
